html: † אֶלְקֹשִׁי adj.gent. c. art. Nahum the Elkoshite Na 1:1 (perhaps = from Elkosh, but locality unknown; identified by JerComm. with a village Elcesi in Galilee; cf. also Capernaum (= כְּפַר נַחוּם?) Elkosh near Mosul improbable; on etymol., and site of place, v. DaNahum, etc., 9 ff. GASmTwelve Proph. ii. 79f.).
